dispute_ticket.description: The driver took a different road than the route I saw and I was charged $28.40 on the meter instead of the $25.80 estimate. I want the extra charge refunded.

chat_logs.content: PIE exit ahead is closed, I need to take Clementi Road instead, about 1.8 km longer. Ok?
Why is the driver on a handsfree call the whole time?

app_events.details: Rider R-9103 booked RydeTAXI. Metered fare; navigated route estimate 17.0 km.
Traffic feed: PIE exit to Clementi Avenue 6 closed to all traffic until 16:00.
Navigation rerouted around the closure. Extra distance versus the original route: 1.8 km.
Meter stopped. Actual distance 18.8 km. Metered fare S$28.40 charged.

deviation_refund.text: Where a driver leaves the navigated route, no refund is due if the platform has recorded a road closure or reroute event on that route, the driver told the rider by in-app chat before turning, the rider agreed, and the extra distance matches the recorded reroute. Otherwise the rider is refunded the metered fare x (actual distance - estimated distance) / actual distance, rounded to the nearest cent.

fare_type.text: RydeTAXI trips are charged by meter rather than at a fixed upfront fare.

expected_outcome.reason: The platform recorded road_closure_recorded at 12:20:30 and reroute_applied at 12:21:00 with an extra 1.8 km; actual 18.8 km minus estimated 17.0 km = 1.8 km, which matches. The driver told the rider in chat at 12:21:10, before the turn (GPS shows the turn by 12:22:00), and the rider agreed at 12:21:30. Under this trip's rule no refund is due, so S$0.00. The higher meter charge follows from the recorded reroute, and the handsfree call remark is a side issue.
